checks.detail: Repair independently verified across all six conditions: manifest has zero todo tokens and locates data-status=open (cond0); steps 1-7 unchanged vs loop-25 and all actions/assertions inside the frozen contract vocabulary (cond1); the fault gate refuses drive_not_started before golden_path_drive_start, is process-local, consumes exactly once at the create_task boundary, and the manifest declares the three PRD 9.2 phases (cond2); minWidth 390 unclamps the window and the host captured a real 390x844 viewport with narrow-Today integrity pass (cond3); register-url-handler.sh emits handler_before/handler_after plus one JSON event line and nothing invokes it at startup (cond4); the host white-box receipt on this sha shows tsc, vite build, cargo fmt --check, cargo check, and cargo test 52/0 green with CSP/capabilities unchanged (cond5). Criterion stays blocked: journey_drive and external_activation receipts are still missing (host-owned lanes, missing_receipt), so the PRD 3 release gate and the PRD 9.2 network-error state are unmeasured, and one observed minor defect exists: Calendar at 390x844 overflows horizontally by 68px (PRD 9/9.2), while today/inbox/projects/focus/settings narrow all pass. Everything the host could observe on this candidate passes (build, UI separation, six hydrated surfaces, embedded assets, isolated store).

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD.

developer_outcome.summary: Validated per risk_note.validation: manifest tests (vocabulary/structure/recovery coverage) pass on the updated manifest; white-box suite 52/52 green; fault-gate unit test proves drive_not_started refusal before golden_path_drive_start and exactly-once consumption. Host replay, cold-activation probe, and 390px/network-error capture stay Host-owned dependencies, never claimed.

risk_note.summary: Most likely insufficient_evidence outcome: the Host journey stage consumes only the golden-path steps and ignores newly declared PRD 9.2 phases, or the Host cold-activation stage remains unbuilt, leaving the prd92 and deeplink findings evidence-stalled despite a correct candidate repair.
risk_note.validation: Validate the updated manifest against the frozen contract vocabulary, rerun the white-box suite, and verify the fault gate refuses before drive start; anything still Host-owned stays a declared dependency and is never reported as pass.
risk_note.why_now: Three of four active issues are strategy_exhausted and evidence-stalled with prescribed repairs; the status token is the single blocker for the whole 18-step lane, and the fault and 390px instruments are the only candidate-owned paths to the remaining states.

task_requirements.requirement: No data-status=todo token remains in quality/first-run-journey.json; create_task and complete_task_once assert and locate data-status=open, matching the product's emitted vocabulary.
Steps 1-7 keep their loop-25 green actions, locators, and assertions unchanged, and the manifest validates against the frozen contract's action and assertion vocabulary.

The network-fault instrument returns drive_not_started before golden_path_drive_start, touches only the isolated per-run profile, and the manifest declares fault-trigger, preserved-input error, explicit Retry, and recovered-content phases.
The main window reaches 390px width and a manifest phase asserts narrow-Today hierarchy with no overlapping or off-screen controls.
packaging/linux/register-url-handler.sh emits handler_before/handler_after plus a JSON event line and is invoked by nothing at startup.
tsc, vite build, cargo fmt, cargo check, and the rust unit suite pass on the updated tree with the capability and CSP surface unchanged.
